fire.question.recognition.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] In this demo, what should you do when the marked fire hazard appears?
fire.question.recognition.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The fixture starts with hazard recognition.
fire.question.recognition.option.continu: [SAT REVIEW] Continue the task without responding
fire.question.alarm.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] Which action satisfies the alarm step in this demo?
fire.question.alarm.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The configured alarm action must be completed.
fire.question.alarm.option.skip: [SAT REVIEW] Skip directly to the result
fire.question.equipment_permission.promp: [SAT REVIEW] When does this demo permit the training equipment interaction?
fire.question.equipment_permission.expla: [SAT REVIEW] Real equipment decisions require approved site content; the demo only permits its configured interaction.
fire.question.equipment_permission.optio: [SAT REVIEW] In every fire regardless of conditions
[SAT REVIEW] When this scenario explicitly permits it
[SAT REVIEW] Whenever a trainee chooses it
fire.question.route.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] Which route should be selected in the evacuation step?
fire.question.route.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The supplied fixture identifies a safe exit and treats blocked-route selection as a critical error.
fire.question.route.option.hazard: [SAT REVIEW] A route back into the hazard
fire.question.route.option.safe: [SAT REVIEW] The marked safe exit and muster route
fire.question.reentry.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] How is re-entering the hazard treated by this scenario?
fire.question.reentry.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The re-entry action is marked criticalFail in the supplied fixture.
fire.question.sequence.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] Which comes after recognizing the hazard in the configured sequence?
fire.question.sequence.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The shared scenario definition transitions from recognition to alarm.
fire.question.sequence.option.muster_fir: [SAT REVIEW] Skip the alarm and go straight to the result
fire.question.muster.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] Which action completes the configured Fire practice?
fire.question.muster.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The terminal action combines safe exit and muster in this demo fixture.
fire.question.muster.option.muster: [SAT REVIEW] Reach the safe exit and muster area
fire.question.muster.option.stop_midway: [SAT REVIEW] Stop before completing the route
fire.question.approved_content.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] What governs real equipment and response decisions at a worksite?
fire.question.approved_content.explanati: [SAT REVIEW] This prototype reinforces approved procedures; it does not authorize real-world operations.
fire.question.approved_content.option.de: [SAT REVIEW] This unvalidated app demo alone
fire.question.approved_content.option.si: [SAT REVIEW] Approved site procedures and authorized training
fire.question.approved_content.option.sc: [SAT REVIEW] The numeric demo score alone
gas.question.detector.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] What is the first configured response to the demo detector alarm?
gas.question.detector.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The supplied fixture begins with recognizing the detector alarm.
gas.question.detector.option.inspect: [SAT REVIEW] Inspect and recognize the alarm
gas.question.threshold.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] Does this demo alarm provide a real safe-entry gas threshold?
gas.question.threshold.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The detector state is DEMO_ALARM_NO_THRESHOLD.
gas.question.threshold.option.yes: [SAT REVIEW] Yes, it supplies a universal threshold
gas.question.threshold.option.guess: [SAT REVIEW] A threshold can be guessed from its colour
gas.question.threshold.option.no: [SAT REVIEW] No; real thresholds must come from approved site content
gas.question.visible_gas.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] Can a training boundary prove that gas outside it is safe or visibly detectable?
gas.question.visible_gas.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The boundary is a teaching aid; the app does not measure real gas.
gas.question.visible_gas.option.no: [SAT REVIEW] No; it is a training overlay, not a measurement
gas.question.visible_gas.option.yes: [SAT REVIEW] Yes, the overlay is a gas sensor
gas.question.visible_gas.option.colour: [SAT REVIEW] Yes, gas safety can be decided by colour alone
gas.question.entry.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] How is unauthorized restricted-area entry treated in this demo?
gas.question.entry.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The enter_restricted_zone action is marked criticalFail.
gas.question.ppe.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] Which PPE choice is correct in this software fixture?
gas.question.ppe.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] Actual PPE selection must use approved site procedures and equipment requirements.
gas.question.ppe.option.configured: [SAT REVIEW] The explicitly configured demo PPE option
gas.question.buddy.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] Which choice completes the buddy / attendant step?
gas.question.buddy.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The fixture requires the configured buddy sequence and marks proceeding alone as critical.
gas.question.buddy.option.confirm: [SAT REVIEW] Confirm the configured buddy / attendant sequence
gas.question.evacuate.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] Which action completes this Gas scenario?
gas.question.evacuate.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] The terminal action combines reporting and the marked safe route.
gas.question.evacuate.option.report_safe: [SAT REVIEW] Report and use the configured safe route
gas.question.evacuate.option.ignore: [SAT REVIEW] Ignore reporting and the route
gas.question.authority.prompt: [SAT REVIEW] What must define real confined-space entry rules?
gas.question.authority.explanation: [SAT REVIEW] This unvalidated prototype does not grant entry authorization.
gas.question.authority.option.approved: [SAT REVIEW] Approved site procedures and authorized personnel
gas.question.authority.option.guess: [SAT REVIEW] An unreviewed guess based on this app
